regime_context: Canada/TSX detector shows Big Banks as the dominant eligible theme (perfect breadth, large margin over challenger) but with elevated crowding. The absolute trend gate (validated for drawdown control) is active and helping. Cross-sectional momentum rank-IC is near zero, so leadership signals are a focus lens, not return forecasts. Rotation margin is wide with no confirmed handoff, and macro backdrop is coincident only.
emerging_watch: Base Metals & Copper: the rank-2 challenger (score 0.75) with moderate durability (0.48) but low breadth (0.222). Watch for a confirmed handoff—kill criterion if rotation margin does not narrow below 0.3 within 30 trading days or if Base Metals loses eligibility.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks remain the eligible leader with perfect breadth (1.0) and strong momentum rank (score 1.517). The absolute trend gate supports maintaining a positive directional stance, and the durable leadership structure (one_narrative false, no handoff) argues against prematurely rotating away. Crowding is elevated (z=1.16), which signals a sizing cap but does not justify fading the theme, per reflexivity constraints.
evidence: crowded=true, but guardrails prohibit fading, only capping
theses.dissent: The theme is crowded and the momentum rank itself has no predictive alpha (rank-IC ~0); the overweight may be holding into a mean-reverting drawdown if macro shocks hit financials, especially with unscheduled surprise share at 1.0.

falsifier.text: Big Banks fall below eligibility threshold (gate off) OR rotation margin vs Base Metals narrows below 0.2 and Base Metals becomes the new confirmed leader.

theses.thesis: Silver & Royalties is not eligible under the absolute trend gate, the only validated edge (drawdown/shake-out avoidance). Low durability (0.24) and poor breadth (0.167) indicate trend health is lacking, and previous backtests confirm avoiding ineligible themes reduces volatility and sharp drawdowns. The positive momentum score (0.282) is not a return forecast, so the failure to pass the trend filter outweighs the rank.
evidence: gate_helps=true (validated risk control for this market)
theses.dissent: The theme could be early in a new trend not yet captured by the gate; precious metals may benefit from geopolitical macro narratives (geopolitics dominant theme), and the proxy ETF (XGD.TO) may see flight-to-safety inflows, making the avoidance costly if trend resumes.

falsifier.text: Silver & Royalties becomes eligible (gate turns on) AND its breadth rises above 0.5, indicating trend re-establishment.
